shortBio: Product Manager who builds AI-powered products and owns the business outcomes behind them.
fullBio:
I'm a Product Manager specializing in AI-first consumer products and growth platforms, with a strong focus on owning business outcomes from 0-to-1 product development through monetization and scale.

At Outspark, I work across AI-driven career products serving 2 Lakh+ users, building AI-powered products, optimizing models for cost and quality, and improving unit economics through automation and vendor negotiations.

Before that, I worked in product operations at Coursera and as an Analyst at Enstoa.
story: Today I own monetization and growth funnels across AI-driven career products at Outspark, serving **2 Lakh+ users**. It starts with revenue: I launched two 0-to-1 offerings, Visibility+ (**₹30K**) and Career+ (**₹50K**), and rolled out Job Alerts, a RAG-based job matching engine that delivered **85% match relevancy**, onboarded **2,700+ users**, and generated **₹54L MRR** in its first month. The same engine went on to generate **30% of Career+ customers' interviews**.

Revenue only counts if growth is efficient. I implemented a LinkedIn outreach agent and an AI voice agent to reduce dependence on expensive telesales, and together with a redesigned onboarding flow they raised lead-to-trial conversion by **40%**.

Then I went after the cost side. Moving to an optimized AI model and prompt system cut the cost of each resume by **more than 70%**, and negotiating with two AI agent vendors cut per-seat costs by **89%** (₹3,600 to ₹384) and **20%** (₹1,000 to ₹800).

Along the way I designed the systems that make this scale: a 6-agent LinkedIn content model supporting **10,000 users**, and a Jev-based lead and job-fit qualification system with **98% accuracy**. Now I'm leading an MCP-based autonomous job application project, with automated flows for **Naukri.com, Indeed, and LinkedIn Easy Apply**.

capabilities: Cross-functional leadership across Eng, Design, and Data

philosophy: Own the outcome, not just the launch: great AI products balance quality, cost, and real business value.
